Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting department of agriculture fee-for-service inspection fees from fee restriction provisions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to fee increase restrictions for the department ofagriculture; and amending RCW 43.135.055.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.135.055 and 2001 c 314 s 19 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) No fee may increase in any fiscal year by a percentage inexcess of the fiscal growth factor for that fiscal year without priorlegislative approval. (2) This section does not apply to an assessment made by anagricultural commodity commission or board created by state statute orcreated under a marketing agreement or order under chapter 15.65 or15.66 RCW, or to the forest products commission, if the assessment isapproved by referendum in accordance with the provisions of thestatutes creating the commission or board or chapter 15.65 or 15.66 RCWfor approving such assessments. (3) This section does not apply to fees by the department ofagriculture used to fund feeforservice inspection programs.
